description: This PHP script functions as a test client for the TestLink API, specifically testing whether a user exists by making XML-RPC calls using the IXR_Client class. It sets up test cases, calls the API, and outputs test results and debug information.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for making XML-RPC calls to the server (assumed to be defined in an external library or included via other code).

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test by calling the specified method with arguments on the server via the IXR_Client object.
